reviews.comment: A lot of ppl say he's hard to understand but I don't think so. He has a little accent but nothing bad. Everything is reasonable and he curves as time goes on. He's great.

Ochem 2 is difficult with any teacher. Dr. Xu makes the class easier by providing lots of practice problems, lowering grade thresholds, and offering to work through problems during office hours. I definitely recommend this prof!

His accent makes it hard to understand what he is saying sometimes, but if you really pay attention and follow the slides, the material is easy to follow. The homework is very helpful for studying, but the mock exams are the best to study, and they are also very similar to the exams.

Hard to understand but exams are very straight forward and EXACTLY like the mock exams so just master the mock exams and you will be chill. Offers a lot of bonus questions on exams and lowered the cut off so that an 85% was an A.
He's a really nice guy but ochem is hard and he did not make it any easier
Insanely hard to understand. Probably the hardest professor to understand at TAMU.

Although I had a very hard time understanding him, he was very engaging in lecture and you can tell he is passionate about teaching. He is so nice and considerate and wants you to succeed. This is the hardest class at Texas A&M, I failed every exam and made a B because of the curve. Mock exms are EXACTLY like the actual exams, master those question
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. X is a knowledgeable and caring professor. He explains complex topics in a way that's easy to understand. He wants his students to be successful. His practice exams and additional practice problems are very helpful for exam preparation, and the reaction summaries he provides are a great study tool!
Overall, very unimpressive class. You won't learn much, but it's an easy A.

Provides practice questions and mock exams for everything, which are very similar to the actual tests. Lectures are clear and understandable. Very little HW to do. Do the mock exams and pay attention in class and you will get an easy A.

Dr. Xu is such a nice and caring professor. He wanted as many people to get a good grade in this course and provided a curve and extra credit opportunities. Only thing was that the lectures were a little hard to understand and follow. However, he provided a summary of reactions and their mechanisms for each chapter which I felt were beneficial.

Dr. Xu is very knowledgeable and explains topics really well. His practice exams are similar to the actual exams and he is very generous with his grading. He also curves the grades throughout the semester which is a bonus. He really cares about his students and is always available to answer questions. Definitely take his class if you want to pass.

Dr. X is awesome! He really cares about his students and is always available to answer questions. He is a fair grader and gives partial credit. His practice exams and additional practice problems were really helpful when studying for his exams. He also gives a summary of all the reactions. Take his class if you want to understand Ochem 2!
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is very approachable and adjusted grade cutoffs continuously throughout the course based on performance. He wanted as many people as possible to get an A! Class consists of: weekly OWL HW, just a few in-class iclicker questions (NOT accuracy), and a few exams. It is an in-person style, so you come to class to learn from his slides.

Dr. Xu provided lots of resources for students to succeed in this class e.g. detailed lecture slides, practice exams, and additional practice problems. In addition to curving the class at the end of the semester, Dr. Xu was a fair grader and provided lots of extra credit opportunities! Dr. Xu truly cares about his students, highly recommend!!

Dr.X was a very standard professor, all his lectures were reading off of slides that he posted to Canvas, and the only things to do outside of classes were read the book and do the OWL. Practice exams were very similar to the actual exams, and he was open to curving the class based on test averages. Really nice guy who cares about students.

(This is a continuation of the review below because of the 350 character limit) I never thought it would be possible to make such a tough class easy to learn and comprehend. There is also a practice exam for each exam as well as a summary of reactions. I highly recommend taking him if you wish to understand ochem 2

Absolutely one of the best professors I have ever had, especially considering the difficulty of Ochem 2. He was very helpful and had a clear outline of what the exams would entail. He is very kind and cares about his students' success. His teaching style and reviews are very helpful as well.

Dr. X is amazing. He is always available outside the class for questions that I cannot understand and responds to emails quickly. He explains things very well.  He is dedicated to genuinely helping students understand the topics covered in the lectures. His practice exam and additional questions are very helpful!
